acceptance: MCP tree output for a real exported DuckDB Q1 plan contains its actual operator hierarchy and lineitem scan, not a single generic Node.
MCP summary operator, join and scan counts match a traversal of canonical logical operators, exclude metadata/property dictionaries, and handle absent estimates without fabrication.
Regression tests use canonical exported/rehydrated plans and verify semantic output for scan, join and aggregate shapes; JSON output retains the canonical plan structure.
context:
Reproduced on 2026-10-28 by passing the actual persisted Q1 plan to the MCP render helpers: tree was "├── Node"; summary reported operator_count=47, join_count=0, scan_count=0. Sequenced after the lookup item because both edit benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py.

Guardrails: companion plans are always the canonical QueryPlanDAG dict, so cut over cleanly: delete the native type/children walkers and the unit tests that pin that fictional schema rather than keeping both. Reuse QueryPlanDAG.from_dict and the existing canonical visualization (benchbox/core/query_plans/visualization.py) and complexity counters (benchbox/core/query_plans/insights.py compute_complexity_score) rather than writing a new traversal. Report estimates only when the plan carries them.

Verification rubric: (1) focused regression test fails before the change and passes after; (2) uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 on the touched plan test modules passes; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff/typecheck on touched files pass; (4) a runtime smoke on the real surface described in acceptance is recorded in the PR body.
description: MCP tree and summary helpers expect a type/children native-style tree, not the persisted QueryPlanDAG envelope with logical_root and operator_type. Passing a real exported Q1 plan renders only Node; the summary counts arbitrary dictionaries as operators and reports zero scans. Existing tests use simplified HashJoin/SeqScan fixtures, so they validate a different schema. Extend existing canonical visualization/model traversal rather than retaining parallel incompatible walkers.
